notes: sky.launch returns after 'Setup detached.' + 'Job submitted' — it does NOT wait for Task.setup, so create_instance returned status=starting and opened its ssh tunnel while the ComfyUI/Wan setup was still running detached. Settles Phase A fragility 2.

'Docker container is up.' landed inside the time to UP, so the 7.4 GB compressed runpod/pytorch cuda-devel image pinned by this config's engine fits and pulls fine on the 30 GB disk sky picks. Phase A fragility 5 does not bite at the reach-UP stage.

The util probe's `top` idle parse works on the real image (100.0 extracted from '100.0 id'). It reads 100% idle at the UP transition because setup is detached and had only just been dispatched; the >=3-consecutive-probe rule correctly did not fire.

ssh to the cluster alias is unresolvable until sky finishes provisioning, so utilisation before UP is structurally unobservable on this provider — the sky cluster status is the only health signal available in that window.
This run took 305 s to UP vs 228 s on attempt 2; same SKU, same AZ, same image. Normal provisioning variance, not a regression signal.
